lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice using för att to explain a simple reason or purpose.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Casual colleague talk before or after work about routines and feeling better.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Explaining why someone does an everyday activity.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik talk about exercise, sleep, and why small routines help during a busy week.

main_focus.name: för att for reason and purpose
main_focus.description: Use för att to connect an activity with the reason or purpose behind it.
model_examples: Jag tränar för att må bra.
Jag går hem tidigt för att vila.
Vi tar en paus för att dricka kaffe.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use för att naturally 3-4 times in the dialogue.

allowed_supporting_grammar: basic V2 word order in main clauses
basic modal verbs: kan, vill, ska, måste

vocabulary_target.theme: daily routines, health, and small breaks
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use practical routine words and at least three reason or purpose chunks.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker mentions being tired or needing a break.
dialogue_shape.middle: They compare small routines and explain reasons with för att.
dialogue_shape.ending: They choose one small action that should help.

target_complexity.repetition: some natural repetition of för att is helpful

focus: the reason for taking a break or changing routine
the expected result of the activity

sentence_focus: one sentence explaining a routine with för att
one sentence about taking a pause
one sentence about going for a walk
one sentence linking an action to må bra
